explanation: Mathlib has `CongruenceSubgroup.Gamma0` (Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms/CongruenceSubgroups.lean) but only basic membership/congruence/finite-index facts about it (e.g. `Gamma0_is_congruence`, `instFiniteIndexGamma0`); it contains no result computing the index `(Gamma0 N).index` nor any product formula for it. The proof's shape resembles Mathlib's `Nat.totient_mul_prod_primeFactors` (Mathlib/Data/Nat/Totient.lean), but that concerns the totient function with factors `(p - 1)`, whereas here the multiplicative function is `(Gamma0 n).index` with factors `(p + 1)`, so it is not an instance or special case of any single Mathlib declaration. Greps for `Gamma0_index`, `index_mul_prod`, `Dedekind` index formulas, and `prod_primeFactors` with `(p + 1)` found nothing matching.
